name: Murls Smart Popups
author: Ahsan Haroon

sections.description:
Murls Smart Popups is the simplest way for WordPress shop owners to create and manage high-converting popups — without touching a single line of code.

Whether you want to announce a sale, display a promotional message, or engage visitors at the right moment, Murls Smart Popups has you covered. Set it up in minutes and let it do the heavy lifting for you.

⭐ Built for shop owners, not developers. Clean. Simple. Powerful.

Why Shop Owners Love Murls Smart Popups

Stop annoying your visitors with the same popup over and over. Our smart cookie management remembers who has already seen your popup and when — so you stay in control of how often it appears. Update your popup content? Every visitor automatically sees the fresh version, no manual cookie clearing needed.

Key Features

✅ Easy popup builder — Create, edit, and delete popups from a clean, intuitive admin panel. No coding, no page builders required.

✅ 3 powerful popup types — Choose from Announcement, Subscriber, or Engagement popups to match your goal.

✅ One-click image picker — Instantly add images from your WordPress Media Library to make your popups visually compelling.

✅ Smart cookie management — You decide how often visitors see each popup: every visit, once per hour, once per day, weekly, monthly, or just once per browser (forever).

✅ Automatic cookie reset on update — Changed your offer or updated your image? Murls Smart Popups automatically resets visitor cookies so every visitor sees your latest version — even if they’ve dismissed the popup before.

✅ Zero performance impact when inactive — Popup scripts and styles are only loaded when you have at least one active popup. When everything is off, your site is untouched.

✅ WooCommerce compatible — Works seamlessly on any WordPress site, including WooCommerce stores.

✅ Multisite ready — Works across WordPress multisite networks.

✅ Translation ready — Fully translatable for international sites.

How the Smart Cookie Reset Works

Every time you save a popup, Murls Smart Popups checks whether the visible content — title, message, or image — has changed. If anything is different, the plugin quietly increments the popup’s internal version number. Because the visitor’s browser cookie is tied to that version, an old cookie for “v2” is simply ignored when the popup is updated to “v3.” The result: your visitors always see your most current popup, automatically.

Perfect For

  • WooCommerce store owners running flash sales, promotions, or seasonal campaigns
  • Bloggers & content creators building their email list
  • Small business websites announcing news, hours, or events
  • Agencies & freelancers managing client sites with multisite

Coming Soon

We’re actively developing Murls Smart Popups. Here’s what’s on the roadmap:

  • 🎯 Display conditions — Show popups only on specific pages, categories, or products
  • ⏱ Advanced triggers — Scroll depth, time on page, and exit intent rules
  • 📧 Email integrations — Connect directly to Mailchimp and other providers
  • 📊 Analytics dashboard — Track views and click-through rates for every popup
sections.installation:
Option 1 — Install from WordPress Admin (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Murls Smart Popups.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Navigate to Murls Smart Popups in your admin sidebar to create your first popup.

Option 2 — Manual Upload

  1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the .zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin and visit Murls Smart Popups in your sidebar to get started.
sections.faq:
Will visitors see the popup on every single page visit?

No — you’re in full control. Each popup has a “Show popup again after” setting where you can choose how frequently it reappears. Options include: every visit, once per session, once per hour, once per day, once per week, once per month, or once per browser (forever).

If I update my popup, will visitors who already dismissed it see it again?

Yes, automatically. Whenever you change the title, message, or image of a popup, the plugin increments its internal content version. This invalidates the visitor’s old cookie, so they’ll see the updated popup on their next visit — without you having to do anything manually.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Absolutely. Murls Smart Popups works on any WordPress website and integrates naturally with WooCommerce stores. It’s a great way to highlight promotions, announce free shipping thresholds, or grow your customer email list.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The frontend stylesheet and JavaScript are only loaded when you have at least one popup set to Active. If all your popups are inactive, zero extra files are loaded — your site’s performance is completely unaffected.

Does the plugin collect visitor data?

No. Murls Smart Popups does not collect, store, or transmit any visitor data whatsoever. The only browser storage it uses is a small dismissal cookie scoped to your own domain — used purely to remember whether a visitor has seen the popup.

Is the plugin compatible with multisite?

Yes. Murls Smart Popups supports WordPress multisite networks, including a multisite-aware uninstall handler that cleans up properly across all sites.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. All user-facing strings are fully translatable using standard WordPress translation tools.

1.2.0

  • Added: WordPress Media Library image picker — add images to popups with one click.
  • Added: Configurable cookie expiry — choose from session, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or forever.
  • Added: Smart content versioning — updating popup content automatically resets visitor cookies so everyone sees the latest version.
  • Added: Multisite support in the uninstall handler.
  • Improved: Full WordPress Coding Standards compliance throughout the codebase.
  • Improved: All strings are now translatable.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Popup list, add/edit/delete functionality, three popup types, and active/inactive status toggle.
